requirement.description: The base Builder class incorrectly raises a TypeError when encountering async generators in synchronous builders, causing multiple test failures in async builders.
requirement.contract: Update the base Builder.__call__ method to properly detect and handle async generators, raising a more informative error message or handling them gracefully rather than raising TypeError.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method has incorrect handling of generators that become list iterators, causing RuntimeError: super(): no arguments in multiple test cases.
requirement.contract: Fix the SeqBuilder.__call__ method to properly handle generators that are converted to list iterators by ensuring proper inheritance and method resolution order, particularly when dealing with empty sequences.

requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder inherits from Builder but doesn't override __call__ properly, causing issues with async generator detection.
requirement.contract: Ensure AsyncOptionBuilder properly implements the __call__ method to handle async generators correctly, potentially by adding explicit async support or preventing async generator usage in synchronous contexts.

requirement.description: The base Builder.__call__ method has issues with method resolution order when calling super() in certain contexts, resulting in RuntimeError: super(): no arguments.
requirement.contract: Refactor the base Builder.__call__ method to ensure proper super() calls and handle edge cases where method resolution order is affected, particularly in inheritance chains.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder._send method needs to properly handle StopIteration exceptions to prevent runtime errors in generator processing.
requirement.contract: Modify the SeqBuilder._send method to properly handle StopIteration exceptions and ensure consistent behavior when processing generators that may yield values or terminate normally.
